answer: Audits are recorded in zephyr, queued in jade, and ferrous publishes the wait time. A farm of 48 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 25 identities per epoch. A farm of 2340 identities would post 919 proofs and burn roughly 90 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
